name: Ability
overview: Scripture reveals that ability is a God-given empowerment, as seen in Exodus 31:3 where God fills individuals with wisdom, understanding, and skill for their work. This divine gifting comes with responsibility, as Luke 12:48 teaches that much given requires much accountability. Believers are created in Christ for good works (Ephesians 2:10) and are to use their diverse gifts according to the grace received (Romans 12:6), living by faith in the Son of God (Galatians 2:20) and faithfully stewarding what has been entrusted to them (Matthew 25:14).
